messages:
marta: quick idea — before we ship the support console 'preview' that shows sampled req/resp snippets, we should gate by per-tenant quota headroom and apply a deterministic fuzzy-redact so we never leak identifiers.
joni: +1 on gating. are you thinking sampling happens at ingress or when console requests the snippet?
sam: ingress is easier for auditability but costs more storage. console-on-demand avoids storing cleartext but complicates rate checks.
marta: goal is: console should be able to show short previews without needing full unredact. UX wants a human-readable masked snippet (emails -> e***@g***.com, long strings hashed) and a confidence flag if we truncated sensitive fields.
liyah: legal wants no full PII in any preview snapshot. we can allow deterministic pseudonymization (hmac) so support can correlate across sessions but not see raw vals.
platform-bot: note: existing sampler metrics lack per-tenant remaining budget metric. filing ticket INF-6423 to expose quota headroom to console via read-only endpoint.
joni: ok so flow: 1) request arrives -> ephemeral preview token created (TTL 10m) if quota available. preview token tied to tenant and sampler budget. 2) console calls preview endpoint with token -> endpoint streams masked snippet. no persistent storage of raw snippet.
sam: preview token sounds good. what about audit logs — we still need to record that a preview was generated and by whom, without storing content.
ops-sre: audit must include tenant, operator id, token id, and sampling rule id. that satisfies compliance for now. avoid storing body.
marta: edge case: a single tenant with very high traffic could consume all preview budget quickly. propose per-operator soft-limit and a cooldown window (e.g., 1 preview / 30s) surfaced in UI.
joni: UI should show 'preview budget' meter and disable preview button when <5% remaining. avoid surprise for CS.
liyah: legal: also require an explicit consent checkbox for manual previews (support must ack they understand PHI risk) — add to product checklist.
sam: implementation note: masking library needs to be deterministic and configurable per-route (some routes return attachments we can't mask well). propose per-route mask profiles stored in config service.
marta: can we reuse existing hash rotation key? we must rotate keys quarterly per policy.
platform-bot: reminder: key rotation will invalidate older pseudonyms; ticket INF-6521 to add a rotation window mapping for short-lived previews.
ops-sre: operationally, preview token creation should be cheap and rate-limited at the API gateway to protect authz flows. prefer token issued by authz service.
joni: telemetry: we want events: preview.requested, preview.issued, preview.displayed, preview.rate_limited. attach rule_id + masked_field_count + tenant_id.
sam: question: do we allow preview for routes with 'no-preview' tag (e.g., payment details)? i'd say block outright, show request to escalate to legal.
liyah: agreed. we'll maintain an allowlist/denylist per route; legal will review denylist entries quarterly.
marta: rollout plan: feature flag by tenant. start with internal + 3 beta customers. collect telemetry for two weeks, check for accidental PII surfacing (we'll run automated redaction fuzz tests).
joni: console UX: show small heatmap of preview usage + last 24h previews per operator so CS sees patterns.
sam: add server-side lint that runs masked sample through a detector model to estimate remaining PII leakage; if score > threshold, refuse preview and route to redact-workflow.
ops-sre: for canary: enable on a dedicated staging cluster with separate quota counters to simulate exhaustion scenarios.
platform-bot: CI check: must add integration tests for token TTL, key-rotation compatibility, and telemetry events; failing tests will block merge.
marta: action items: @joni add quota headroom endpoint ticket, @sam implement preview token + mask profiles, @liyah coordinate legal consent copy, @ops-sre design rate limits and CI canary plan. I'll assemble a one-pager for PM and CS.
joni: will do. linking design doc draft: https://internal.redwood/notes/preview-mask-proposal
sam: i'll spike mask lib prototype tomorrow and post results in #eng-platform.
liyah: legal will review draft by EOD Friday.
ops-sre: ETA for infra changes? need ~2 sprints for quota endpoint+rate limits.
marta: ok thanks — let's reconvene after spikes. small ask: keep preview tokens auditable and revocable via console in case of misuse.
joni: noted. we'll add revocation API.
marta: thanks everyone :rocket:
platform-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment started for feature-flag 'console-preview' on staging cluster at 2026-03-21T15:02:17Z :shipit:
